I lead [openwashdata](https://openwashdata.org), a global open-data community for the water, sanitation and hygiene (WASH) sector, and I teach reproducible data science with R and Quarto. My background is in environmental and hygiene engineering, with field research on faecal sludge management across Uganda, Vietnam, Haiti and South Africa.

Use the navigation above to explore my [research](research.qmd), [software and open data](software.qmd), [teaching](teaching.qmd), and [media](media.qmd), or read the full [CV](cv.qmd).
